# glpi_rack_item (Data Source)

Look up a GLPI rack placement of an item.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "glpi_rack_item" "example" {
  id = "42"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) GLPI numeric ID.

### Read-Only

- `background_color` (String) Background color of the item in the rack view.
- `horizontal_position` (Number) Position inside a unit shared by half-width items.
- `item_id` (Number) ID of the placed item.
- `item_type` (String) GLPI itemtype of the placed item, for example Computer or NetworkEquipment.
- `orientation` (Number) 0 for the front of the rack, 1 for the rear.
- `position` (Number) Lowest rack unit the item occupies.
- `rack_id` (Number) ID of the rack.
- `reserved` (Boolean) Reserve the units without an item.
